description: qou-vr3q: the 4₁ Stokes matrix S⁺(x;q), and its q→0 Stokes constant 3, computed from the triangulation 3d index through the GGM gauge; exact.

data.source: GGM 2012.00062 tex: eq Sp-41, W41rec, W41xm, WW41 (+footnote), S0x41; DGG 1112.5179 eq 4.18
data.verdict: The figure-eight Stokes matrix S⁺(x;q) is assembled from the DGG 3d index alone (bare eq 4.18, two tetrahedra) through the explicit gauge L = P·K(x⁻¹)⁻¹·T₀(x⁻¹;q⁻¹)⁻¹, R = T₀(x;q)⁻ᵀ·K(x)⁻ᵀ·Q fixed by GGM's proved Wronskian relations (W41rec at m=-1, W41xm at m=0) and the Stokes formula eq (Sp-41). At q→0 it gives S⁺(x;0) = [[1, x⁻¹+1+x],[0,1]]: the Stokes constant 3 = (1+x)·[I_41(0,0)]_{q⁰} + x·x⁻²·(-[I_41(1,-2)]_{q^{1/2}}) at x=1, i.e. the vacuum (counted with the gauge weight 1+x) plus one BPS state at magnetic flux 1, electric charge -2. Full x-series match GGM's printed 𝒮⁺ through q², det S⁺ = 1, the GGM symmetry 𝒮₁₂ = -𝒮₂₁, and at x=1 the printed towers (61)-(64) through q⁶ and the W-route S⁺(q) coefficientwise. Conditional on GGM conj.41M and the block factorisation of the index (proved by GGM for 4₁). Side finding: GGM eq (S11v) misprints the q-coefficient weights of S⁺₁₁(x;q). Scope-(a); exact integers; no fit; no measured value.
